title: Small Habits, Big Changes
excerpt: A few simple habits can make your everyday routine feel calmer and more organised.
body: Big changes do not always start with big actions. Start with one small habit, such as planning tomorrow before sleeping, reading a few pages, or taking a short walk. Keep the habit easy enough to repeat. Over time, consistency can make a real difference.

title: Getting Started with React
excerpt: Understand components, props, and state through a beginner-friendly approach.
body: React helps developers build user interfaces using components. A component is a reusable piece of UI. Props allow a parent component to pass information to a child, while state stores information that can change over time. Build small examples first and practise often.

title: Making Time for Creativity
excerpt: You do not need a perfect plan to begin creating something meaningful.
body: Creativity grows when you give yourself room to experiment. Keep a small sketchbook, write down ideas, or try a new colour combination. Focus on the process rather than making every result perfect. A little regular practice is often more useful than waiting for inspiration.

title: A Weekend Travel Checklist
excerpt: Plan a short trip without forgetting the little things that make it easier.
body: Before a weekend trip, check transport timings, weather, accommodation details, and your estimated budget. Pack essential documents, chargers, medicines you normally use, and comfortable clothes. Leave some flexible time in your schedule so the trip feels enjoyable instead of rushed.

title: Simple Ways to Learn Better
excerpt: Make study sessions more useful with small changes to your routine.
body: Choose one clear goal before you start studying. Break large topics into smaller sections, test yourself without looking at notes, and take short breaks. At the end, write down what you understood and what needs another revision. Active recall helps you notice gaps in your learning.

title: Why Every Project Needs a README
excerpt: A clear README makes it easier for someone else to understand and run your project.
body: A README introduces a project and explains how to use it. Include the purpose, main features, tools used, setup commands, and any known limitations. Clear instructions make collaboration easier and help you remember how the project works when you return to it later.
